note: D3 an avoided tile is a cost, never a wall: the same drill bot with fire on all four of its neighbours has no detour left to buy, so the cheapest path is still through the flames - it steps west onto (3,2), takes the enter damage and then the environment tick standing there (2 of its 3 hp, both signed fire:env), and the ring burns out to ash around it. This is the case the Content.ENEMY_AVOID_COST doc names: a ring of fire is never an immortal fence, the enemy walks through when that is the cheapest way. sap_snare on (3,2) pins where it ended up
